content.title: Akshaya Tritiya 2026: Date, Shubh Muhurat, Significance, Wishes
content.text: Akshaya Tritiya 2026 is one of the most auspicious Hindu festivals, celebrated on Sunday, 19 April 2026. Known for bringing prosperity, success, and eternal growth, this day is considered ideal for new beginnings, investments, and spiritual activities.👉 If you are searching “when is Akshaya Tritiya in 2026” or “Akshaya Tritiya kab hai” — it falls on 19 April 2026.The word “Akshaya” means never diminishing, symbolising wealth, happiness, and success that continues to grow over time.Festival: Akshaya TritiyaDate: Sunday, 19 April 2026🕒 Akshaya Tritiya 2026 Puja MuhuratShubh Muhurat: 10:49 AM to 12:20 PMDuration: 1 Hour 32 Minutes⏳ Tritiya Tithi TimingTritiya Tithi Begins: 10:49 AM on April 19, 2026Tritiya Tithi Ends: 07:27 AM on April 20, 2026🔍 Important Note👉 Akshaya Tritiya is considered a self-auspicious day, meaning you can perform puja, buy gold, or start new ventures throughout the day. However, the above muhurat (10:49 AM – 12:20 PM) is considered the most शुभ (auspicious) time.Akshaya Tritiya 2026 Date and Muhurat OverviewAkshaya Tritiya, one of the most auspicious Hindu festivals, is celebrated for prosperity, wealth, and new beginnings. In 2026, the festival spans across two days — April 19 and April 20, offering extended शुभ मुहूर्त for gold purchase and rituals.🪔 Akshaya Tritiya 2026 Gold Purchase Muhurat Timings📅 Sunday, April 19, 2026Shubh Muhurat Start: 10:49 AMShubh Muhurat End: 05:51 AM (April 20)Total Duration: 19 Hours 02 Minutes✨ Auspicious Choghadiya Timings:Morning Muhurat (Chara, Labha, Amrita): 10:49 AM – 12:20 PMAfternoon Muhurat (Shubha): 01:58 PM – 03:35 PMEvening Muhurat (Shubha, Amrita, Chara): 06:49 PM – 10:57 PMNight Muhurat (Labha): 01:43 AM – 03:05 AM (Apr 20)Early Morning Muhurat (Shubha): 04:28 AM – 05:51 AM (Apr 20)📅 Monday, April 20, 2026Shubh Muhurat Start: 05:51 AMShubh Muhurat End: 07:27 AMTotal Duration: 01 Hour 36 Minutes✨ Auspicious Timing:Morning Muhurat (Amrita): 05:51 AM – 07:27 AM📍Akshaya Tritiya 2026 Muhurat in Major CitiesBelow are the city-wise muhurat timings (local time):Pune – 10:49 AM to 12:34 PMNew Delhi – 10:49 AM to 12:20 PMChennai – 10:49 AM to 12:08 PMJaipur – 10:49 AM to 12:26 PMHyderabad – 10:49 AM to 12:15 PMGurgaon – 10:49 AM to 12:21 PMChandigarh – 10:49 AM to 12:22 PMKolkata – 10:49 AM to 11:36 AMMumbai – 10:49 AM to 12:38 PMBengaluru – 10:49 AM to 12:19 PMAhmedabad – 10:49 AM to 12:39 PMNoida – 10:49 AM to 12:20 PM🧠 What is Akshaya Tritiya?What is Akshaya Tritiya?Akshaya Tritiya is a sacred festival celebrated on the third day (Tritiya) of Shukla Paksha in Vaishakh month. The word “Akshaya” means eternal or never-ending, indicating that good deeds and investments made on this day multiply and bring lasting benefits.🌟 Significance of Akshaya Tritiya💰 Symbol of ProsperityActions performed bring long-lasting rewardsIdeal day for financial investments🙏 Spiritual ImportanceWorship of Lord Vishnu, Lakshmi, and GaneshaDay of purity, positivity, and blessings📜 Mythological SignificanceBirth of ParashuramaStory of Akshaya Patra (Mahabharata)Beginning of Treta Yuga👉 True prosperity is not just wealth but also nourishment, sharing, and continuity.💰 Why Do People Buy Gold on Akshaya Tritiya?Gold symbolises wealth and stabilityBuying gold is believed to attract prosperityJewellery and coins are commonly purchased👉 Traditionally, people also bought:Brass utensilsCopper vesselsThese represented daily life, nourishment, and sustainability.🙏 What to Do on Akshaya Tritiya🪔 Perform PujaOffer prayers to Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi🏠 Start Something NewBegin a business, project, or investment🛍️ Make Meaningful PurchasesGold, property, or useful household items🤝 Donate and Do CharityDonate food, clothes, or essentials👉 Charity on this day is believed to bring multiplied blessings.🌍 Akshaya Tritiya 2026 in Hindiअक्षय तृतीया 2026 एक शुभ दिन है जो 19 अप्रैल 2026 को मनाया जाएगा।इस दिन किए गए अच्छे कार्य और निवेश कभी कम नहीं होते और जीवन में सुख-समृद्धि लाते हैं।🎉 Akshaya Tritiya Wishes✨ Happy Akshaya Tritiya WishesHappy Akshaya Tritiya! May your life be filled with prosperity and happinessMay this day bring success and endless growthWishing you wealth, health, and positivityAkshaya Tritiya Wishes in Marathiअक्षय तृतीयेच्या हार्दिक शुभेच्छा!तुमच्या आयुष्यात सुख, समृद्धी आणि यश लाभो🖼️ Akshaya Tritiya Images & Celebration IdeasPeople often share:Akshaya Tritiya imagesFestive greetingsPuja visualsGold purchase moments👉 Social sharing increases awareness and festive joy.📊 Key Facts About Akshaya TritiyaCelebrated annually in April–MayBased on lunar calendarKnown as Akha TeejConsidered self-auspicious dayConclusionAkshaya Tritiya 2026 is more than just a festival—it is a reminder that true prosperity lies in meaningful actions, generosity, and continuity. Whether you start something new, perform charity, or celebrate with family, the essence of the day lies in intentions that never diminish.👉Happy Akshaya Tritiya!🌼
